classification: OWNER_APPROVED_ADAPTATION: partner grades S/A/B/C with a capture head start inside each individual's own native bounds (P1), and same-line fusion that feeds Sync EXP only (P2) (LINE_FUSION_TAMER_TALENTS_DESIGN_20261117)

saveField.path: progression.syncLevels.partners[instanceId].grade = { grade: 'S'|'A'|'B'|'C', q: [6 integers inside the grade's band] }
saveField.migration: none: a partner without it has no grade and shows '—'; an unknown shape is dropped and the Sync level kept (productSyncLevel.normalizeSyncLevels)

rules.grades: S 5 % (q 85-100), A 20 % (65-84), B 35 % (35-64), C 40 % (0-34); ELITE and ANCESTOR wild instincts are never below A
rules.noise: instinctNoise(salt, actorIndex, speciesIndex, 058, 060, 064, 068, 06c, 018), salt 0x50 for the grade and 0x51-0x56 for the six q values; the native hunt RNG is never read
rules.headStart: for 058, 05c, 060, 064, 068, 06c with bounds at 0xa8 + i*8 (upper) and 0xac + i*8 (lower): value = min(upper, max(native value, lower + unit * floor(q/100 * 0.4 * (upper - lower) / unit))), unit 10 for HP and 1 otherwise; 050/054 fill to the new maximum; written once on the Home commit before the elite gain
rules.reveal: hidden during the Hunt, shown on the Hunt Result row and the partner list

notChanged: the native individual roll, the native hunt RNG and the encounter
each individual's upper and lower bounds
the native release history (a fused partner does not return to the wild)
the save key, schemaVersion and the save lock

fusion.line: fodder of the base's own species x1.0; a lower stage reached by walking the base's ancestors backwards x0.6; anything else is refused (FUSION_LINE_MISMATCH); side branches are never followed
fusion.exp: one fodder = round(EXP the base needs at its current level x 0.25 x grade x line) + floor(Sync EXP the fodder had gathered x 0.5); grade S 1.6, A 1.25, B 1.0, C 0.8, none 1.0; at most 5 fodder a fusion, each paid on the base's level at that moment; past Lv.50 the EXP becomes crystals
fusion.fodder: a catch on the memory card (Hunt Result) or a saved partner; never the base itself or the main partner (which is also the starter egg). No dispatch/rental occupancy exists in this build.
fusion.warnings: a saved fodder at Sync Lv.10 or above, with learned burst forms or a gachapon bloodline is listed before the confirmation
fusion.huntResult: requestHuntResultFusion / confirmHuntResultFusion(baseId) stage the fusion like a release; the catch leaves the memory card at once, a saved fodder leaves with releasedHomeIds, and the Sync EXP is written by the Home commit in the same save; a fused catch takes no roster slot and no ranch G
fusion.ranch: fusePartners(baseId, fodderIds) on the partner list: one save; a failed save changes nothing
fusion.writes: progression.syncLevels only (base EXP, fodder records removed); the native release history, the native individuals and the Dex registration are not written
